info.description:
Skyline Student Association platform — phases 1-7: auth & membership, events & tickets, announcements, merchandise, fundraisers & tasks, expenses & treasurer finance.

All endpoints are under `/api/v1`. Errors are `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`; lists are `{"items", "total", "page", "page_size"}`. Money is integer paise. Timestamps are UTC and always end in `Z`. See `docs/API_HANDOFF.md` for the client guide.

post.description:
The post, the audience it resolves to and the delivery rows are one transaction. Email goes
only to members who have not opted out. The worker is kicked as soon as this response is sent,
and again by the 60-second job, so `delivery_summary` is a queue count, not a receipt.

patch.description:
Any change to title, body or category requires `revision_note` (3+ characters) and stores
the version being replaced in the revision history. `audience` and `event_id` are frozen once
posted (422 AUDIENCE_LOCKED). Pinning needs no note, but still counts against the pin limit.

get.description: `summary` always counts the whole announcement; `items` is the filtered, paginated rows.
Each row is the version that was replaced, who replaced it and why.

post.description:
Two separate guards: a per-IP sliding window for volume, and a per-email lockout after
`LOGIN_FAILURES_BEFORE_LOCKOUT` consecutive failures. The lockout is what makes a slow
password-guessing run against one known email pointless.

Both refuse without saying whether the account exists - the message names no email, and a
locked account and a rate-limited one look the same from outside.
